# Build + test dependencies for the CI test image (Dockerfile.ci-test).
#
# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the `make test-ci-local` Docker image and for the
# ci-test-noble-amd64 GHCR image that test.yml's c-tests and c-asan jobs run
# in: edit this file to add or remove a test dependency.
# scripts/test-ci-local.sh rebuilds the local image when this file changes
# (Docker layer cache); builder-images.yml republishes the GHCR image when it
# changes on main. On a branch that changes it, dispatch builder-images.yml
# for that branch so CI sees the new packages before the merge.
#
# Installed with apt's default recommends (as the c-tests job installed them on
# the ubuntu-24.04 runner before it moved into this image), so the toolchain
# (gcc, gcov, lcov) is Ubuntu 24.04's.
#
# One package per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
make
gcc
pkg-config
check
lcov
python3
python3-yaml
libao-dev
libavcodec-dev
libavformat-dev
libavutil-dev
libavfilter-dev
libjson-c-dev
libgcrypt20-dev
libcurl4-openssl-dev
libwebsockets-dev
libasound2-dev
libblas-dev
liblapack-dev
# CI job tooling: actions/checkout needs git in the container, and
# codecov/codecov-action downloads and verifies its uploader with curl + gpg.
git
ca-certificates
curl
gnupg
